title: Octopus Musician and Death
description: A blue octopus wearing a pink beret plays a glowing violin, emitting colorful musical notes and symbols from its body. A translucent green hooded figure resembling the Grim Reaper stands beside it, holding a tall dripping pink candle with a turquoise flame, set against a dark mountainous landscape under swirling purple and blue skies.
